Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements: Maxroll A endgame (8th) and A push (9th of 20) for 'Bone Spirit Necro', whose planner includes this 'Desecrated' profile [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]; d4builds C for 'Bone Spirit' (the SKULM page), with an unguided 'Shadow Dot' A that may be this build [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds: unranked, but Akiha's 'Desecrated Bone Spirit' guide (updated 2026-09-15) 'works for Torment XII in most situations' and is 'a daily build, not for pushing tiers' [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/2srC9YLZrx - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement: Maxroll A vs d4builds C - the widest split in the class. Second in the class under the owner's tie-break (d4builds tier, then d4builds in-tier order, then InfinityBuilds, then Maxroll): d4builds' C outranks the Shadow Minions hybrid, which d4builds does not place; InfinityBuilds disagrees, ranking Minions A while leaving Bone Spirit unranked. Consensus across all three loadouts: Leoric's Crown, Vengeful Sinew, Fists of Fate, Tibault's Will, The Gloom Ward, Blood-Mad Idol, Seal of the Diamond Mind with Desecration + Black Shroud, Wither + Frailty [Desecration] + Scent of Death + Flesh-eater boards. Disagreements: boots (Penitent Greaves on d4builds and Maxroll vs Path of Trag'Oul on InfinityBuilds); weapon aspect (Decay d4builds, Writhing Maxroll, Gloom InfinityBuilds); bar (see test notes); glyphs (see late-endgame paragon); mercenary. Construction: late endgame = d4builds 'SKULM-S15-BONE SPIRIT', lastUpdated 2026-09-14 [https://d4builds.gg/builds/bone-spirit-necromancer-endgame/ - 2026-09-16]; early endgame and push = Maxroll planner ad1di30q 'Mid Game' and 'Desecrated' [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/ad1di30q - 2026-09-16]; no reference publishes a leveling route. Replaces Blood Lance (Maxroll D on both lists). Untested theorycraft. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Bone Storm on cooldown for attack speed and corpses, Golem's active every 5-10 seconds for Unstoppable (Tibault's Will), keep Skeleton Warriors and Mages alive, then spam Bone Spirit - the Desecration set places corpses and curses for you.
Variants

Leveling — Bone Spirit spam once its Core Skill upgrade is taken; Sever for corpses; Bone Storm on cooldown. (specialist, untested)
Move on when Respec to the Mid Game kit once Leoric's Crown and Vengeful Sinew are equipped.

Early Endgame — Sever for corpses every ~8 s to keep Flesh-eater; Bone Storm for Critical Strike Chance and Attack Speed; Corpse Tendrils to pull, apply Vulnerable and Fortify; spam Bone Spirit. [Maxroll ad1di30q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Switch to the Desecrated setup when you own Seal of the Diamond Mind, four Radamant's Desecration charms, The Gloom Ward and Blood-Mad Idol.

Late Endgame — 1) Bone Storm on cooldown - generates and consumes corpses for the set bonuses and Flesh-eater, plus cast speed and Barrier. 2) Spam Bone Spirit, the Shadow damage-over-time source. 3) Golem active every 5-10 seconds for Unstoppable, which triggers Tibault's Will. 4) Keep Skeleton Warriors (healing) and Skeleton Mages (Essence) alive. [d4builds notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Move to the push kit once Blood-Mad Idol, Fists of Fate and Tibault's Will are Mythic and all splinters are Abyssal.

Pushing — Desecration set automates corpses and curses. Cast Skeletal Mages to consume corpses every 8 s for Flesh-eater; Bone Storm for attack speed; Golem to pull; Bone Prison: Life Imprisonment for attack speed; then Bone Spirit. [Maxroll ad1di30q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Final stage; if the InfinityBuilds Soulrift variant tests stronger (test note 7), swap Golem/Bone Storm for Soulrift and Bone Prison: Plunging Darkness.

Stat requirements
  • Maxroll (Desecrated): 100% Attack Speed - Bone Storm supplies 50% with Bone skill ranks
  • Maxroll (Desecrated): 30k+ Maximum Life
  • Maxroll (Mid Game): 100% Critical Strike Chance, 50% from Bone Storm

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements: Maxroll A endgame (8th) and A push (9th of 20) for 'Bone Spirit Necro', whose planner includes this 'Desecrated' profile [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]; d4builds C for 'Bone Spirit' (the SKULM page), with an unguided 'Shadow Dot' A that may be this build [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds: unranked, but Akiha's 'Desecrated Bone Spirit' guide (updated 2026-09-15) 'works for Torment XII in most situations' and is 'a daily build, not for pushing tiers' [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/2srC9YLZrx - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement: Maxroll A vs d4builds C - the widest split in the class. Second in the class under the owner's tie-break (d4builds tier, then d4builds in-tier order, then InfinityBuilds, then Maxroll): d4builds' C outranks the Shadow Minions hybrid, which d4builds does not place; InfinityBuilds disagrees, ranking Minions A while leaving Bone Spirit unranked. Consensus across all three loadouts: Leoric's Crown, Vengeful Sinew, Fists of Fate, Tibault's Will, The Gloom Ward, Blood-Mad Idol, Seal of the Diamond Mind with Desecration + Black Shroud, Wither + Frailty [Desecration] + Scent of Death + Flesh-eater boards. Disagreements: boots (Penitent Greaves on d4builds and Maxroll vs Path of Trag'Oul on InfinityBuilds); weapon aspect (Decay d4builds, Writhing Maxroll, Gloom InfinityBuilds); bar (see test notes); glyphs (see late-endgame paragon); mercenary. Construction: late endgame = d4builds 'SKULM-S15-BONE SPIRIT', lastUpdated 2026-09-14 [https://d4builds.gg/builds/bone-spirit-necromancer-endgame/ - 2026-09-16]; early endgame and push = Maxroll planner ad1di30q 'Mid Game' and 'Desecrated' [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/ad1di30q - 2026-09-16]; no reference publishes a leveling route. Replaces Blood Lance (Maxroll D on both lists). Untested theorycraft. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Bone Storm on cooldown for attack speed and corpses, Golem's active every 5-10 seconds for Unstoppable (Tibault's Will), keep Skeleton Warriors and Mages alive, then spam Bone Spirit - the Desecration set places corpses and curses for you.
Variants

Leveling — Bone Spirit spam once its Core Skill upgrade is taken; Sever for corpses; Bone Storm on cooldown. (specialist, untested)
Move on when Respec to the Mid Game kit once Leoric's Crown and Vengeful Sinew are equipped.

Early Endgame — Sever for corpses every ~8 s to keep Flesh-eater; Bone Storm for Critical Strike Chance and Attack Speed; Corpse Tendrils to pull, apply Vulnerable and Fortify; spam Bone Spirit. [Maxroll ad1di30q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Switch to the Desecrated setup when you own Seal of the Diamond Mind, four Radamant's Desecration charms, The Gloom Ward and Blood-Mad Idol.

Late Endgame — 1) Bone Storm on cooldown - generates and consumes corpses for the set bonuses and Flesh-eater, plus cast speed and Barrier. 2) Spam Bone Spirit, the Shadow damage-over-time source. 3) Golem active every 5-10 seconds for Unstoppable, which triggers Tibault's Will. 4) Keep Skeleton Warriors (healing) and Skeleton Mages (Essence) alive. [d4builds notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Move to the push kit once Blood-Mad Idol, Fists of Fate and Tibault's Will are Mythic and all splinters are Abyssal.

Pushing — Desecration set automates corpses and curses. Cast Skeletal Mages to consume corpses every 8 s for Flesh-eater; Bone Storm for attack speed; Golem to pull; Bone Prison: Life Imprisonment for attack speed; then Bone Spirit. [Maxroll ad1di30q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Final stage; if the InfinityBuilds Soulrift variant tests stronger (test note 7), swap Golem/Bone Storm for Soulrift and Bone Prison: Plunging Darkness.

Reasoning

HypothesisThe Shadow damage-over-time Bone Spirit - Radamant's Desecration 4-piece plus Peace of the Black Shroud 2-piece through Seal of the Diamond Mind, Leoric's Crown holding Splinters of Hellfire and Pain, Blood-Mad Idol with Aspect of Debilitating Darkness - should out-scale the class's direct-hit builds at high Pit tiers, because 3.2.1 raised exactly its multipliers (Desecration 2-piece 30% to 50%, 5-piece 225% to 250%; Debilitating Darkness 15-25% to 30-40%; Gloom 15-20%[x]; core stat 1.625), Hellfire's -100% Critical Strike Chance drawback costs a damage-over-time build almost nothing, and the Desecration set automates corpses and curses so Bone Spirit can be spammed. It is also the most likely reading of d4builds' unguided 'Shadow Dot' A: d4builds' own Bone Spirit page calls itself 'a Shadow DoT build' that 'will be one of the strongest Necromancer builds for Season 15'. Every piece is published by at least one reference; what is untested is this thesis and the seam between sources.
Confidencemedium
How to test it1) Does Seal of the Diamond Mind ('Reduces the number of Charms needed for Set bonuses by 1') make four Desecration charms grant the 5-piece 250%? The whole talisman plan rests on it. 2) Soul Splinter cap: official text says up to three in jewelry; every reference loadout here sockets five (two in Leoric's Crown + three in jewelry) - check which ones actually apply. 3) Two Hellfire splinters (d4builds: crown + amulet) - do identical splinters stack? 4) Leoric's Crown gem-effect bonus: feed 35-50%[x] vs PTR 75-100%. 5) Blood-Mad Idol converts incoming damage to Burning; with Tibault's Will regeneration halved to 25% in 3.2.1, is the build still 'very tanky' (SKULM)? 6) Golem active must be pressed every 5-10 s for Unstoppable -> Tibault's Will; measure uptime. 7) Compare bars: d4builds (Sever, Bone Storm, Golem, Skeleton Mage, Skeleton Warrior, Bone Spirit) vs Maxroll Desecrated (Bone Prison instead of Sever) vs InfinityBuilds (Soulrift: Distilled Anima 'your Darkness damage is increased by 30%[x]' and Bone Prison: Plunging Darkness 450%, both 3.2.1 buffs). The InfinityBuilds bar is the variant most directly built on 3.2.1's Darkness buffs and the first alternative to test.

Flame Surge

Core skillAldkin

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Fate: Aflame

Basic Attack: Fire Shot

Aldkin channels a cone of flame for 4 seconds, repeatedly dealing 80% Fire damage.

Aldkin's Mercenary Core Skill alters his Fate and Basic Attack.

Aldkin hurls a flaming bolt at an enemy, dealing 90% Fire damage and 55% Burning damage over 4 seconds.

Haunt

Core skillAldkin

Cooldown: 14 seconds

Fate: Forsaken

Basic Attack: Shadow Strike

Aldkin emits 3 ghostly souls at enemies, each Haunting their victims and dealing 90% Shadow damage over 10 seconds. If a target dies while being Haunted, its soul jumps to another target.

Aldkin's Mercenary Core Skill alters his Fate and Basic Attack.

Aldkin shoots a burst of shadow bolts at an enemy, each dealing 30% Shadow damage.

Storm of Fire

Iconic skillAldkin

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Aldkin rains a Fire Storm down from the sky that deals 300% Fire damage on impact and remains on the ground for 10 seconds. Every second, the Fire Storm Burns enemies within for 55% damage over 2.5 seconds.

Enemies hit by Fire Storm's impact or aftershocks have a 30% chance to be Stunned for 1.0 |4second;seconds.

Wave of Flame

Iconic skillAldkin

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Aldkin conjures a mass of flames forward, repeatedly dealing 550% Fire damage, Knocking Back enemies, and destroying small missiles.

Field of Languish

Iconic skillAldkin

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Aldkin desiccates an area for 6 seconds, Slowing enemies within by 40% and reducing their damage dealt by 20%.

Chain of Souls

Iconic skillAldkin

Cooldown: 21 seconds

Aldkin chains up to 10 enemies to himself, Tethering to them and dealing 84% Shadow damage over 2.5 seconds.

When the chains expire, they deal 35% Shadow damage and Stun their victims for 2.5 secondseconds.

Terrify

PassiveAldkin

Hits of Aldkin's Haunt have a 30% chance to inflict Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.

Exhaustion

PassiveAldkin

Aldkin's Shadow damage has a 10% chance to Daze enemies for 2 seconds.

Paranoia

PassiveAldkin

Lucky Hit: Attacks against Languishing enemies have up to a 20% chance to Daze them for 1.0 secondseconds.

Languishing enemies take 15%[x] increased damage from you.

Condemned

PassiveAldkin

You instantly kill Languishing enemies with less than 40% Life. Does not work on Elites.

Shared Pain

PassiveAldkin

Aldkin's Chain of Souls Cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds when a chained target dies.

Amplified Suffering

PassiveAldkin

Damaging a Soul Chained enemy detonates the chain early, dealing 50% Shadow damage around them.

Covered in Ash

PassiveAldkin

Hits of Aldkin's Flame Surge Slow enemies by 20% and deal an additional 60% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

Raging Violence

PassiveAldkin

Allies gain 15%[+] Critical Strike Chance against enemies affected by Flame Surge.

Ember's Gift

PassiveAldkin

You restore 33 Resource per second while inside Aldkin's Fire Storm.

Eradication

PassiveAldkin

Enemies killed within Aldkin's Fire Storm explode for heavy Fire damage.

Raging Havoc

PassiveAldkin

Enemies damaged by Aldkin's Wave of Flame take 15%[x] increased Damage Over Time for 4 seconds.

Burning Chaos

PassiveAldkin

Aldkin's Wave of Flame Cooldown resets when you cast an Ultimate Skill.
